estimated_alternative.design: Run a 30-assignment randomized comparison inside the existing unfinished-original and coverage quotas: 15 current-policy assignments versus 15 quality-gated assignments. The gate requires exact source binding and either retained lesson/rival evidence or a cheap unresolved-audit triage; it does not use high loss as a defect signal.
estimated_alternative.estimated_direction: The gate should improve usable four-query evidence per review minute for this sampled mix, but effect size is unknown and must be measured.
estimated_alternative.label: estimate_only_not_policy_change
estimated_alternative.primary_metric: fraction yielding a source-bound, Racket-labelled episode with at least four distinct queries identifiable from demonstrations against declared rivals

priority: source-bound semantic/rival evidence with a missing four-query/parameter package
unresolved originals only after a bounded triage; replace still-unresolved candidates with the next record from the same representation stratum
quality_gate_arm.representation_constraint: preserve the current unfinished-original versus coverage stratum counts within the 15 assignments

estimated_alternative.stopping_rule: Stop after 30 assignments, or early when the Wilson 95% interval for the primary-rate difference excludes zero by at least 15 percentage points. Stop for harm if the gated arm lowers any protected source-stratum share by more than 10 percentage points or raises median authoring minutes by more than 25%.
